DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りはどのような方法ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車です。かごへ横に寝かせれば、包装があるので大丈夫だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装付き花束を自転車かごで横置きする予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Bisikleta po. Akala ko dahil may balot, ayos lang ihiga sa basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang planong ihiga sa bike basket ang nakabalot na bulaklak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 包装だけで、どの向きでも運べるとは限りません。花束の状態と運び方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi nangangahulugang puwede sa anumang direksiyon dahil may balot. Tiyakin natin ang bouquet at pagdadala.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 包みを見て判断していました。保水している部分の向きも含めて、運び方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 包装と運搬適性を分け保水部も含む説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Balot lang po ang pinagbatayan ko. Pakituro ang pagdadala pati direksiyon ng bahaging may tubig.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang balot at pagiging angkop sa pagdadala at humiling ng paliwanag pati sa tubig. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この花束は担当が持ち方を示します。かごへ押し込めるかを先に試さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ipapakita ng namamahala ang paghawak. Huwag munang subukang isiksik sa basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 押し込みません。かごの大きさでは余裕がないので、自転車でそのまま運ぶ予定を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 押し込まず自転車運搬を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po isisiksik. Walang sapat na puwang kaya gusto kong baguhin ang planong diretsong dalhin sa bike.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag isiksik at baguhin ang bike transport. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取り方法を変える場合は、保管や受取り時刻を確認します。別の方法は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung babaguhin ang pagkuha, tiyakin ang storage at oras. May napili na bang ibang paraan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自転車を家へ置いて、歩いて戻れるか考えています。預かってもらえると決めず条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 徒歩再来店を検討し預かり条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Iniisip ko pong iwan ang bike sa bahay at maglakad pabalik. Hindi ko ipapalagay na puwedeng iwan; pakisabi ang kondisyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Isaalang-alang ang pagbalik nang naglalakad at itanong ang pag-iingat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が本日の預かり条件を案内します。花束はここに置いたまま確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang kondisyon ngayon. Iwan muna rito ang bouquet habang tinitiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。預かりの条件が合えば受取りを変え、戻った時に教わった向きで手に持って運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預かり可否確認後に受取変更と教わった向きでの運搬を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Kung tugma ang kondisyon, babaguhin ang pickup at pagbalik ay dadalhin sa kamay sa itinurong direksiyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Matapos matiyak ang pag-iingat, baguhin ang pagkuha at dalhin sa itinurong direksiyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当に確認します。持ち方と受取り方法を一緒にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Itatanong sa namamahala. Sabay ipapaliwanag ang paghawak at pagkuha.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のどの案内についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Aling impormasyon po sa parcel ang tanong?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙を見て再配達を頼みに来ました。不在だったので、荷物は郵便局へ戻ったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在案内を再配達と思い郵便局へ戻ったと解釈したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nakita ko po ang papel at humiling ng redelivery. Dahil wala ako, akala ko ibinalik sa post office ang parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pag-aakalang redelivery notice at ibinalik sa post office. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この紙には宅配ボックスへ配達したとあります。ご自宅のボックスは確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nakasulat dito na naihatid sa parcel locker. Natingnan na po ang locker sa bahay?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。配達済みとあっても、私が手元で受け取ったわけではありません。まず置かれた場所を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配達済みと本人受取を区別しボックス位置確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa po. Kahit delivered, hindi ko pa hawak na natanggap. Gusto kong tiyakin muna ang pinaglagyan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang delivered at personal na pagtanggap at itanong ang locker. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ボックス番号と開けるための案内があります。お問い合わせ番号とは別の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: May box number at gabay sa pagbukas. Ibang field sa inquiry number.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 追跡用の番号を入力しようとしていました。ボックスの番号と開け方の案内を分けて読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追跡番号とボックス番号と開け方を読み分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tracking number po sana ang ilalagay ko. Hiwalay kong babasahin ang locker number at pagbukas.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Basahin nang hiwalay ang tracking, locker number at pagbukas. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の荷物について指定されたボックスだけを確認してください。開けられなければ、その状態をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itinakdang locker para sa sarili ninyong parcel lang ang tingnan. Sabihin kung hindi mabuksan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号が読みにくいので、近くの別のボックスで試しません。建物の管理担当にも、開け方を確認する必要があるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不鮮明な番号で別ボックスを試さず設備担当への確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Malabo po ang numero kaya hindi susubok sa katabi. Gusto kong itanong kung kailangan ding tiyakin sa building manager ang pagbukas.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag subukan ang ibang locker sa malabong numero at magtanong sa equipment manager. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 機械の操作は管理担当への確認が必要です。配送については、配達記録を担当へ照会できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa management tiyakin ang operasyon. Sa delivery, maaaring itanong sa staff ang delivery record.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ではこの紙を残し、指定のボックスと操作案内を確認します。開けられない場合は、配送記録と設備の操作をそれぞれの担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を保持し配送記録と設備操作の相談先を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Itatabi ko po ang papel at titiyakin ang itinakdang locker at operation guide. Kung hindi mabuksan, hiwalay sa kani-kaniyang staff ang record at kagamitan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itabi ang gabay at ihiwalay ang tanungan sa delivery record at equipment. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今は再配達の申し込みとして処理せず、配達先のボックス情報を確認する相談として引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Hindi redelivery request ang ipoproseso; ipapasa bilang pagtiyak sa destination locker.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 積み込みは、青い車から白い車へ変更します。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sa puting sasakyan na sa halip na asul ang loading.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 白い車は別の方面へ行く印象がありました。箱の宛先も白い車に合わせて書き直すのですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車両変更で荷物宛先も直すのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-02.translation: Akala ko po ibang direksiyon ang puti. Isusulat din bang muli ang destination ng kahon para tumugma?
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung babaguhin din ang destinasyon dahil ibang sasakyan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回は車両の変更です。荷物の配送先を変更する指示ではありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sasakyan lang ang binago. Hindi utos na baguhin ang delivery destination.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。ラベルは触らず、変更された車両の番号を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配送先は維持し当日の車両番号確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sige po. Hindi gagalawin ang label at gusto kong tiyakin ang bagong vehicle number.
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang destination at humiling ng vehicle number ngayon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが当日の割当です。箱数と配送先の照合も、積み込み担当と行ってください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito ang assignment ngayon. Itugma ang box count at destination kasama ng loader.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十二箱とあります。隣の便の二箱を加えるのでなく、この便の十二箱だけ確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当該便十二箱を隣便の荷物と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Labindalawa po. Hindi idaragdag ang dalawa sa katabing trip; labindalawa lang ng biyaheng ito.
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang labindalawa ng kasalukuyang trip sa katabi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。運転者が着いたら、便の番号で照合します。車体の色だけで載せないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Pagdating ng driver, itutugma sa trip number. Huwag kulay lang ang batayan ng loading.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ積みません。白い車が二台あっても、当日の便番号と合った方へ担当の指示で運びます。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車色でなく便番号と担当指示で積むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi pa po magkakarga. Kahit dalawang puti, sa tugmang trip number at utos ng staff ko dadalhin.
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing trip number at utos, hindi kulay, ang batayan ng loading. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認は私が一緒に行います。元の車へ運びかけた荷物はありますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sasamahan ko sa pagtiyak. May nasimulang dalhin sa dating sasakyan?

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 台車に二箱ありますが、車内には入れていません。十二箱のうちの二箱として場所を報告します。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未積込二箱は十二箱の一部として所在を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-10.translation: May dalawa po sa trolley pero wala pa sa loob. Iuulat ang lugar bilang dalawa sa labindalawa.
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iulat ang dalawang hindi pa naikarga bilang bahagi ng labindalawa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その状態から確認しましょう。ラベルと便番号を照合して積み込みます。
DLG-SC-TKY-KOTO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Mula roon ang pagtiyak. Itugma ang label at trip number bago magkarga.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの券は、別の路線の一日券ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ibang linya po ang one-day ticket na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一日乗れる券なので、モノレールも同じ日に使えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一日有効なら他交通機関でも使えると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Dahil isang araw po, akala ko pati monorail ay magagamit sa araw na iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pag-aakalang balido sa ibang transport kung isang araw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付の有効範囲と、使える交通機関は別です。券の対象路線をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang validity date at transport na sakop. Tingnan ang target line sa tiket.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 路面電車と書いてあります。今日という条件だけ見て、路線の欄を見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 有効日と対象路線を区別して表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Tram po ang nakasulat. Araw ngayon lang ang nakita ko at hindi ang route field.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang araw at sakop na linya at tingnan ang label. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この学習場面では、モノレールの利用には別の券が必要です。目的地はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa learning situation na ito, ibang tiket para sa monorail. Saan po ang destinasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 港駅です。路面電車の券を捨てて買い直すのでなく、二つを別に保管したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的地と別券保管の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Minato Station po. Hindi ko itatapon ang tram ticket para bumili; hiwalay kong itatabi ang dalawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang destinasyon at hiling na magkahiwalay na itabi ang tiket. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: モノレールの区間券をご案内します。路面電車の券は、その対象内で使えるか別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ituturo ang monorail section ticket. Hiwalay na tiyakin ang paggamit ng tram ticket sa saklaw nito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。帰りに路面電車を使う予定です。モノレール購入で一日券も新しくなるとは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別交通券の購入が既存券更新ではないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Tram ang balak sa balik. Hindi ko iisiping nababago ang day ticket kapag bumili ng monorail.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Unawaing hindi pag-renew ng dating tiket ang pagbili ng iba. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この区間券でモノレールに乗ることをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Gusto po bang sumakay sa monorail gamit ang section ticket na ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今日の一日券と区間券を取り違えず、使う路線に合った方を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 路線ごとに適切な券を出すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Hindi ipagpapalit ang day at section ticket; tamang tiket sa linyang gagamitin ang ilalabas.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyaking angkop na tiket bawat linya ang ipapakita. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: モノレールの券はこちらです。対象の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ito ang monorail ticket. Tingnan ang sakop.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取り寄せ品のお受け取りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kukunin po ang ipinakuha sa ibang tindahan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙に別の店名があります。そちらの店で払った扱いで、今日は受け取るだけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出荷元店名を支払済み記録と解釈したと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: May ibang store name po rito. Ibig bang doon na bayad at kukunin lang ngayon?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pag-aakalang payment record ang shipping-store name. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その店名は在庫のある出荷元です。支払いの記録ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Store na may stock at pinagmulan iyon. Hindi payment record.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 取寄せを頼む時に代金は渡していませんでした。店名があるので、会計が済んだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼時は未払いだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po ako nagbayad noong humiling. Dahil may store name, akala ko tapos na ang bayad.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi pa bayad noong humiling. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では受け取り店で会計します。商品を見てから購入を決めるご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito, sa pickup store magbabayad. Gusto munang makita bago bumili?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。届いたサイズと色を確認したいです。取り寄せの依頼だけで必ず買う条件だったかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品確認と取寄せ時の購入条件の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Titingnan ang size at color. Pakisabi rin kung obligadong bumili noong humiling ng transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Humiling ng product check at paliwanag ng purchase conditions sa transfer request. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご依頼時の条件を照合します。この場面では確認後に購入を決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itutugma ang dating kondisyon. Sa sitwasyong ito, puwedeng magpasya matapos tingnan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。出荷元へ勝手に連絡して返品するのではなく、この店で選び方を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出荷元へ自己返品せず受取店で相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sige po. Hindi ako sariling tatawag sa pinagmulan para i-return; dito ako magtatanong sa pagpili.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag sariling ibalik sa source store at kumonsulta sa pickup store. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 届いた商品はこちらです。ご希望のサイズと合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ito ang dumating. Tugma sa nais na size?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合っています。こちらで払って購入します。出荷元の名前を支払い場所と混ぜないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した商品を受取店で支払って購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tugma po. Dito ko babayaran at bibilhin. Hindi ko ihahalo ang source store name at payment location.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bilhin at bayaran sa pickup store ang natiyak na produkto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。この店での購入記録をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Ibibigay ang purchase record ng tindahang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 焼く時の用具について、ご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ipapaliwanag po ba ang kagamitan sa pag-ihaw?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。私が焼いた肉の横に友人が新しい肉を置き、どれがいつ置かれたか分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追加肉と先に置いた肉が混ざり順序が不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pakiusap po. Naglagay ang kaibigan ng bagong karne sa tabi ng inihaw ko, kaya hindi na alam kung alin ang kailan inilagay.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nahalo ang bago at nauna at hindi tiyak ang pagkakasunod. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 状態を見分けたつもりで召し上がらず、担当へ相談してください。まだ食べていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Huwag kumain sa pag-aakalang nakilala ang kalagayan; itanong sa staff. Hindi pa po kinain?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食べていません。私が最初に置いた三枚と、友人が後から置いた二枚が混ざっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未食で先三枚と後二枚の経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa po. Tatlo kong nauna at dalawa niyang huli ang nahalo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi kinain at ipaliwanag ang unang tatlo at kasunod na dalawa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経緯を確認します。用具も、生の肉を扱うものと分ける案内があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ang pangyayari. May gabay ding ihiwalay ang kagamitan para sa hilaw.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ用具を使ってよいとは決めず、担当の説明を聞きたいです。新しい肉を追加するのはいったん止めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用具の使い分けを確認し追加を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po ipapalagay na puwedeng pareho; pakikinggan ang staff. Ihihinto muna ang dagdag na karne.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang paghihiwalay ng kagamitan at ihinto ang dagdag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当がこちらで状態と用具の扱いをご案内します。色だけで置いた順番を判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Dito ipapaliwanag ang kalagayan at gamit. Huwag kulay lang ang pagbatayan ng pagkakasunod.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友人へも、追加した二枚の位置を覚えているか聞きます。私の記憶を友人の操作の記録にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 色や自己記憶で同行者の操作を断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Tatanungin ko rin kung naaalala niya ang puwesto ng dalawa. Hindi ko ituturing na tala ng galaw niya ang sarili kong alaala.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag magpasya sa kilos ng kasama batay sa kulay o sariling alaala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かる範囲をお伝えください。確認するまで料理の状態を変えずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sabihin ang alam ninyo. Huwag baguhin ang pagkain habang wala pang pagtiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。五枚の経緯と用具の使い方を確認してから、担当の案内で食事を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現状態で担当確認を受けてから食事を続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Itatanong ang takbo ng lima at gamit, saka magpapatuloy ayon sa gabay.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpatuloy sa pagkain matapos matiyak ng staff ang kasalukuyang kalagayan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当を呼びました。お二人で説明をお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tinawag na ang staff. Pareho ninyong pakinggan ang paliwanag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 前の列は、水がかかる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Maaaring mabasa ang mga nasa unahang hanay.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は後ろへ座りますが、かばんは前の空席へ置いても大丈夫ですか。席があれば濡れないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 後列に自分だけ座り前列へ荷物を残す案を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa likod po ako uupo pero puwede bang sa bakante sa unahan ang bag? Akala ko hindi basa kung may upuan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Magtanong sa planong sa likod ang sarili at sa unahan ang bag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空席でも水がかかる可能性はあります。お荷物もご自身の席へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kahit bakante, maaaring mabasa. Dalhin ang gamit sa sariling upuan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。人が座っていないことと、乾いた場所ということは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空席と水がかからない場所を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sige po. Magkaiba pala ang walang nakaupo at tuyong lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang bakanteng upuan at lugar na hindi nababasa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。後方でも濡れない保証ではありません。濡れて困る物は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Hindi rin garantisadong tuyo sa likod. Ano pong ayaw mabasa?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類です。袋の口を閉じて自分で持ちます。後ろへ移るだけで十分とは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類を袋へ収め後列も乾燥保証ではないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dokumento po. Isasara ang supot at hahawakan ko. Hindi ko iisiping sapat ang paglipat sa likod lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ilagay ang dokumento sa supot at unawaing hindi garantiya ang likod. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移動する時は、通路や他のお客様の視界をふさがないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Huwag harangan ang daan o tanaw ng iba sa paglipat.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。開始前に友人と荷物をまとめて移ります。途中で前の席へ取りに戻らない計画にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開始前に人と荷物を移し途中回収を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Bago magsimula, sabay kami ng kaibigan at gamit lilipat para hindi bumalik sa unahan sa gitna.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ilipat ang tao at gamit bago magsimula upang maiwasan ang pagbalik sa gitna. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 後方の空いている席をご案内します。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。二人分の席と荷物を一緒に移し、書類の袋も閉じてから見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人の席と荷物を同時に移して鑑賞する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Sabay ililipat ang dalawang upuan at gamit, at isasara rin ang document bag bago manood.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ilipat nang sabay ang upuan at gamit ng dalawa bago manood. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの席です。荷物は周囲の通行を妨げない位置へ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dito ang upuan. Ilagay ang gamit nang hindi nakaharang.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 請求の使用量についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa billed usage ang tanong?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。メーターは四百と表示されていますが、紙の使用量は二十です。少なく書かれているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 累積表示と請求使用量の不一致を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. 400 sa meter pero 20 ang usage sa papel. Kulang po ba ang naisulat?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang di-pagkatugma ng cumulative display at billed usage. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メーターの表示と、期間内の使用量は別に確認します。請求の検針日は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang meter at period usage. Nababasa ang reading date sa bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週です。私が四百を見たのは今日なので、測った日も同じではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自身の確認日と検針日は異なると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Noong nakaraang linggo po. Ngayon ko nakita ang 400 kaya magkaiba rin ang petsa ng pagsukat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing magkaiba ang sariling tingin at meter reading date. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 前回と今回の検針記録を担当が照合します。ご自身で差額の金額を計算して支払う話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Itutugma ng staff ang nakaraan at kasalukuyang meter records. Hindi sariling kakalkulahin ang diperensiya at babayaran.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日の累積表示を今月一回の使用量として、金額を増やして払わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 累積値で支払額を自己修正しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sige po. Hindi ko ituturing na isang buwang usage ang cumulative ngayon at dadagdagan ang bayad.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag sariling baguhin ang bayad ayon sa cumulative value. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 請求書と、今日確認した日時をお知らせください。表示の写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ibigay ang bill at oras na nakita ngayon. May photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。小数の部分も写っていますが、その数字の読み方まで自分で決めず、写真のまま見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日時付き原写真を示し小数の読みを推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mayroon po. Pati decimal pero hindi ko sariling huhulaan ang pagbasa; buong larawan ang ipapakita.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang orihinal na larawang may oras at huwag hulaan ang decimal reading. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。いまの請求の扱いも確認結果と一緒にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapasa sa staff. Gagawin sa bill ay ipapaliwanag kasabay ng resulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。二つの日付と表示と使用量を分け、正しい記録の説明を受けてから対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録時点と期間使用量を照合した説明後に対応する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Ihihiwalay ang dalawang petsa, display at usage at kikilos matapos maipaliwanag ang tamang tala.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Kumilos matapos maihambing ang oras ng tala at period usage. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当窓口へご案内します。請求書と写真をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Igagabay sa tamang counter. Dalhin ang bill at photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お受け取りの商品は、まだ到着していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hindi pa po dumating ang kukunin ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二時の便と書いてあったので、今夜の二時に受け取れると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 午前二時の便を今日の夜の続きと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: May alas-dos na biyahe po kaya akala ko makukuha sa alas-dos ngayong gabi.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pag-aakalang 2 a.m. trip ay kasunod ng gabi ngayon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内の日付も確認しましょう。午前二時は、どの日に指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tingnan pati ang petsa. Anong araw nakatakda ang alas-dos ng umaga?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明後日の日付です。今日の夜の続きだと思いましたが、もう一日後なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定日がもう一日後だと読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Makálawa po. Akala ko pagkatapos ng gabi ngayon, pero isa pang araw pala.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Basahin muli na isa pang araw ang nakatakdang petsa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 到着予定と、受け取れる状態になった案内は別です。受取通知は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hiwalay ang arrival plan at ready-for-pickup notice. May pickup notice na?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。便の予定だけで取りに来ました。通知を受けてから来る必要があるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取通知未着で予定だけを根拠に来たと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Wala pa po. Plano ng biyahe lang ang dahilan ng pagpunta. Kailangan bang maghintay ng notice?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang pickup notice at plano lang ang batayan ng pagpunta. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では、受け取り可能の通知後に番号を提示してください。夜中に来る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito, ipakita ang numero matapos ang ready notice. Hindi kailangang hatinggabi pumunta.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では日付だけで急いで来ず、通知と受取期限を確認して、昼の時間に来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開始通知と期限を確認して昼に来たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kung ganoon, hindi ako magmamadali sa petsa lang; titiyakin ang notice at deadline at sa araw pupunta.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing titiyakin ang simula at deadline at nais pumunta sa araw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知には受取期限も記載されます。期限内でご都合のよい時間をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Nasa notice rin ang deadline. Tingnan ang maginhawang oras sa loob nito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。予定便と受取開始を混同せず、通知を待ってから番号と期限を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定便と受取可能状態を分け通知後に手続する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Hindi ihahalo ang planned trip at pickup start; hihintayin ang notice bago tingnan ang numero at deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang plano at ready status at magproseso matapos ang notice. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品到着後の案内をご確認ください。今日は受け取りの受付は行いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tingnan ang guide matapos dumating ang produkto. Walang pickup registration ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はまとめてでよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三人で割りたいですが、一人は最後の飲み物だけです。注文人数が三人なら同じ額に分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参加人数と同額割勘を対応させてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tatlo po naming hahatiin pero huling inumin lang ang isa. Kung tatlo ang tao, maaari bang parehong halaga?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung katumbas ng bilang ng tao ang equal split. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店の会計方法と、お客様同士の負担の決め方は別です。注文した内容は明細で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang store billing at sariling hatian. Nasa itemized bill ang order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では均等にしたいと私だけが決めず、遅れて来た友人にも相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 負担は全員で合意すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po ako mag-isang magpapasya ng pantay; kakausapin ko rin ang nahuling kaibigan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Magpasyang lahat ang magkakasundo sa hatian. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認用に明細をお渡しします。まだお支払いは始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ibibigay ang detalye para tingnan. Hindi muna magsisimula ng bayad.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。先に二人で食べた料理と、後の飲み物を分けて見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先の料理と後の飲料を明細で区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Salamat po. Hiwalay kong titingnan ang pagkain ng naunang dalawa at huling inumin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay sa bill ang unang pagkain at huling inumin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに項目があります。店でそれぞれの負担を判断する話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Dito ang items. Hindi tindahan ang magpapasya ng bahagi ng bawat isa.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。店の明細を使って自分たちで合意します。料理を食べた人が一人減ったから、注文を一品消す依頼でもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内部負担調整が料理取消しではないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Sa sarili naming usapan gagamitin ang bill. Hindi rin kami humihiling magbura ng pagkain dahil nabawasan ang kumain.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Linawing hindi kanselasyon ang panloob na hatian. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合意後のお支払い方法をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagkatapos magkasundo, pag-usapan ang paraan ng bayad.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三人で話しました。会計は私が全額払い、友人から受け取る額は別に決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全額一括払いと仲間内精算を分けて確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Napag-usapan na po. Ako ang buong magbabayad at hiwalay naming itatakda ang ibabalik ng mga kaibigan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyaking hiwalay ang isang buong bayad at sariling paghahati. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。全注文を含む金額で、まとめて会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-KOTO-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Isang bayad para sa buong order ang ipoproseso.
